newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Automation net slumps on tough market.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Automation net slumps on tough market.

text.p: Shanghai Automation Instrumentation Co Ltd said on Saturday a 41 percent drop in net profit in 1996 was due to tougher market conditions.

Net profit slumped 40.88 percent to 26.72 million yuan in 1996, compared with 45.19 million in 1995 based on international accounting standards, the company said in its annual report, published in the Shanghai Securities News.
The firm on Friday reported 1996 net profit of 48.23 million yuan based on domestic accounting standards, down from 59.51 million in 1995.
Slack demand for its products, sharper competition and funding shortages caused the drop in profits, the company said.
Although turnover increased in 1996, it could not offset the effects of inflation and the reduction of tax rebates due to changes in government policy, it said.
The company's board of directors have proposed a one-for-10 bonus issue, pending approval at a June 20 shareholders meeting.
